navigation.title: Choose a workspace
navigation.description: Use the navigation on the left to choose the knowledge area, records, and other workspaces.

interview.title: Run the interview
interview.description: Follow the conversation with AI, enter answers, and organize knowledge step by step.

knowledge.title: Review knowledge context
knowledge.description: Use the knowledge panel on the right to review the question list and interview results.

composer.title: Send an answer
composer.description: Enter an answer in the composer at the bottom and send it. You can also switch to a voice interview.
